paragraphs: Biogas production and microbial communities in the anaerobic digestion of sewage sludge under hydrothermal pretreatment with air and a catalyst
Van Toi Phama, Pei-Hsun Wua, Chung-Yu Guanb, Chia-Chi Changa, Bo-Liang Liua, Ching-Yuan Changa, Chang-Ping Yua,c*
a Graduate Institute of Environmental Engineering, National Taiwan University, Taipei 106, Taiwan

Table S1 Effects of HTP time on the characteristics of SS at 180oC and N2 as working gas

Control, RT30, RT60, and RT90 present the characteristics of the untreated SS and treated SS at 180 °C, 648.1 kPa and with nitrogen as the working gas during the residence time: 30, 60, and 90 min, respectively
Table S2 Effects of HTP working gas on the characteristics of SS at 180oC during 30 min
TH and WAO represented HTP using nitrogen and air as the working gas
Table S3 Effects of HTP catalyst on the characteristics of SS at 180oC, 30 min and air as the working gas
C0, C5 and C10 represent the values of pretreated SS that K2CO3 was added to the reaction at 0, 5 and 10wt% of the TS of the sample, respectively

Fig. S1 Yield of methane and carbon dioxide in biogas in 100 mL bottles: (a) changing the residence time of HTP at 180oC and N2 as working gas. Control, RT30, RT60, and RT90 present the characteristics of the untreated SS and treated SS at 180 °C, 648.1 kPa and with nitrogen as the working gas during the residence time: 30, 60, and 90 min, respectively; (b)changing working gas of HTP at 180oC and 30 min of residence time. TH and WAO represented HTP using nitrogen and air as the working gas; (c) with and without adding catalyst in WAO at 180oC and 30 min of residence time. C0, C5 and C10 represent the values of pretreated SS that K2CO3 was added to the reaction at 0, 5 and 10 wt% of the TS of the sample, respectively

Fig. S2 Accumulative yield of methane and carbon dioxide in AD: (a) with changing the residence time of HTP at 180oC and N2 as working gas; (b) with changing working gas of HTP at 180oC and 30 min of residence time; (c) with and without adding catalyst in WAO at 180oC and 30 min of residence time

Fig. S3 Methane and carbon dioxide production rate under effects of HTP time, working gas and catalyst. (a), (b), (c) and (d) present the untreated SS and treated SS at 180 °C, 648.1 kPa and with nitrogen as the working gas during the residence time: 30, 60, and 90 min, respectively. (e), (f) and (g) represent the pretreated SS at 180 °C, 648.1 kPa and with air as the working gas during the residence time 30 min, with K2CO3 added at 0, 5 and 10wt% of the TS, respectively

Fig. S4 Taxonomic classification of microbial community. (a) Order (Archaea). (b) Genus (Archaea). (c) Phylum (Bacteria). (d) Class (Bacteria). (e) Genus (Bacteria). M1 depicts the AD of raw SS. M2, M3 and M4 represent the AD of pretreated SS under 180 °C, at 648.1kPa, with no catalyst, N2 as the working gas and 30, 60, and 90 min of residence time, respectively

Fig. S5 Taxonomic classification of microbial community. (a) Order (Archaea). (b) Genus (Archaea). (c) Phylum (Bacteria). (d) Class (Bacteria). (e) Genus (Bacteria). M1 depicts the AD of raw SS. M2 and M5 show the microorganisms in AD of pretreated SS under 180 °C, 648.1kPa, 30 min of residence time, using nitrogen and air as working gas, respectively

Fig. S6 Taxonomic classification of microbial community. (a) Order (Archaea). (b) Genus (Archaea). (c) Phylum (Bacteria). (d) Class (Bacteria). (e) Genus (Bacteria). M1 depicts the AD of raw SS. M5, M6 and M7 show the microorganisms in AD of pretreated SS under 180 °C, 648.1kPa, 30 min of residence time, air as working gas and K2CO3 added 0, 5 and 10 wt% of TS of sample, respectively
